jobs.description:
As a Production Operator, you will be responsible for ensuring that all materials required for the process are ready for use and that the production process runs smoothly. You will also test the finished product according to work instructions and specifications. It is essential that all activities are carried out in a safe working environment. If unsafe situations arise, you are responsible for stopping the work.

In this role, you will be responsible for carrying out standard operating and/or assembly and disassembly activities, both manually and with the help of control panels. You will report any irregularities to the Machine Operator or (Assistant) Shift Supervisor.

In the event of equipment malfunctions, depending on the level of difficulty, you will either attempt to resolve the issue yourself or call in the Technical Service Department. You will therefore perform first-line maintenance on the machines. If you are unable to resolve an issue, you will ask your supervisor for assistance.

You will work a three-shift schedule: One week from 06:00 to 14:00. One week from 14:00 to 22:00. And one week from 22:00 to 06:00. Does this sound like your next challenge? Apply now!

- You have an mbo level 3 equivalent of education or working level
- You have good technical insight and understanding
- You have at least 1 year of experience working in a production environment, preferably in a shift-based role
- You speak English or Dutch and have a good command of English, both written and spoken
- You are able to obtain a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG)

Love driving and looking for a great job? Jump into the cabin of a modern truck! As a C/CE Driver at Bakkerij Visser in Alphen aan den Rijn, you are the face of a family business. You will drive routes to deliver fresh bread to supermarkets every day. And the rewards? Very good! You get a great salary (Bakery CAO) plus extra money for working night hours. Enjoy a flexible job with a good work-life balance, and we will take care of your yearly Code 95 training. Ready to hit the road? 🌍

What we offer
- €18.21 to €22.12 per hour (excluding allowances)!
- Lots of freedom and independence behind the wheel!
- Peace and quiet on the road
- Build your pension from day one!
- Get your Code 95 and other training via Tempo-Team
- Grab those extra's for working nights & weekends!

Who you are
Would you love to work as a driver in a family business? As our driver, you make sure the fresh bread gets to the customers right on time. You are exactly the person we are looking for if you:

- Have a valid C or CE driving license.
- Have your Code 95 up to date.
- Speak and write good Dutch or English.

What will you do
What does your workday look like?

- Early start & coffee: Start your day between 01:30 and 04:00 AM at the bakery in Alphen aan den Rijn with a hot cup of coffee.
- Load up: Load your truck independently with carts of delicious, fresh-smelling bread.
- Hit the road: Drive a fixed route to about 5 or 6 supermarkets (like Jumbo).
- Deliver & handle admin: Unload neatly at the dock, check the delivery notes, take back empty returns, and fill in your trip reports.
- Done by 10:00 AM! Park the truck back at the bakery and enjoy having the rest of the day completely free! 🥖

Where will you work
About your new employer:

- A proud history: You will join Bakkerij Visser in Alphen aan den Rijn, a modern industrial family business that has been around for over 100 years! As part of the Bake Five group, they bake fresh bread for major supermarkets every day.
- One big family:

For the Sealing & Polymer department, we are looking for an enthusiastic Prep & Finish Operator. You will join a dynamic team where quality, precision, and collaboration are key. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that products are carefully prepared and finished, meeting the highest quality standards.

As a Prep & Finish Operator, you are responsible for various activities within the production process. During the prep phase, you clean metal parts using special fluids, sandblast components to optimally prepare the surface, clean them again, and apply a primer. During the finish phase, you use ice blasting to complete the final treatment of the products before they move on to the next stage of the process. You work accurately according to established quality guidelines and, together with your colleagues, ensure that every product is delivered in perfect condition.

You will work a fixed schedule from Monday to Friday during day shifts, from 07:30 to 16:00 or from 08:00 to 16:30. For this position, it is important that you are physically fit and comfortable handling products weighing up to approximately 30 kilograms. In addition, you work carefully, have technical insight, and have a good command of the Dutch and/or English language.

Are you looking for a varied position within an international and innovative company where craftsmanship and quality are highly valued? Apply now and become part of the ERIKS team in Alkmaar!

- You have a calm and focused personality and work accurately and precisely
- You are physically fit and comfortable working with products weighing up to approximately 30 kg
- You communicate clearly when you encounter any issues or challenges
- You have a technical affinity; experience in areas such as ICT, jewelry making, metalworking, or surface treatment is a plus
- You have a good command of the Dutch and/or English language
